exposure: Midline rectovaginal fascial plication (MFP) for rectocele
outcome: Improvement of symptoms (sensation of vaginal bulge)
cohort: The study participants were 34 women with isolated or associated rectocele who underwent midline rectovaginal fascial plication (MFP).
finding: Midline rectovaginal fascial plication (MFP) for rectocele showed encouraging anatomical success (93%) and functional improvement at one year, with 71% of patients satisfied with their surgery.
